cases.variant: fixed revision, fresh portable StoredData, minimize then close then relaunch
cases.why: the fixed application is a clean subject driven through the exact defect trigger, so it must complete the minimize, close and relaunch sequence and place its window back on screen without reporting the sentinel-position defect

observation.observable: BoundingRectangle of the relaunched top-level window

cases.variant: affected revision, fresh portable StoredData, close from the normal visual state with no minimize
cases.why: the same defective build runs the same persist-on-exit and restore path through the same window pattern, so it superficially matches the defect, but closing from the normal state is legal and must not be classified as the sentinel-position failure

observation.observable: BoundingRectangle of the relaunched top-level window

cases.variant: affected revision, fresh settings flags, hold and release F7 instead of F1
cases.why: the same defective build, the same focused search box and the same page observation across both key edges, but F7 is bound to nothing in the MainView handler, so a page move here would be a false positive on the key-timing identity
